data.title: Ostra Palace Villas
data.about:
Palace Ostra Villas at The Oasis is a first Palace-branded villa community in Dubai by Emaar, offering an unparalleled standard of ultra-luxury living in Dubai. Positioned opposite Address Villas Tierra, another prestigious Emaar development, this exclusive enclave features 4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas with expansive layouts, open-style basements, rooftop terraces, and pool access. With fewer units spread across a vast master-planned area, Ostra Palace Villas ensures privacy, exclusivity, and a refined lifestyle. Every home is meticulously designed with premium finishes, high ceilings, and floor-to-ceiling windows, creating a seamless blend of sophistication and comfort.

Located within The Oasis, Ostra Palace Villas offers seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Maktoum International Airport, and Expo City Dubai. The development features resort-style amenities, including a swimmable lagoon, a private beach area, fitness stations, sports courts, and lush green landscapes. With its strategic location, exceptional design, and strong investment potential, Ostra Palace Villas stands as one of the most exclusive villa communities in Dubai, offering a rare opportunity for luxury living and high capital appreciation.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Serene Living at Ostra Palace Villas by Emaar
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Ultra-Luxury Living: First-ever Palace-branded villas in Dubai, offering a level of prestige unmatched in the market.
  • Spacious Layouts: Expansive 4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas, featuring basements, private pools, and rooftop terraces.
  • A Master-Planned Community: Spanning 8.5 million square meters, with only 3,100 villas, ensuring low density and a serene environment.
  • Limited Units: Only 45.2% of land used for villas, with 26% dedicated to premium amenities, and the rest for parks, mosques, and green spaces.
  • Unique Layouts: Some units feature open-style basements, while others offer drop-type basements with direct access to a private swimming pool, enhancing luxury and exclusivity.
  • Strategic Location & Connectivity: Escape the city hustle and embrace the future at Dubai’s new urban hub, just minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport.
  • Exceptional Investment Potential: Luxury-branded villas at this price point are rare, making it an unmissable investment opportunity.

location_tile.title: A Prime Location in The Oasis – Dubai’s Exclusive Waterfront Community
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Nestled within The Oasis, one of Dubai’s most prestigious waterfront communities, Ostra Palace Villas by Emaar offers a serene yet connected lifestyle. This masterfully planned neighborhood is renowned for its tranquil lagoons, lush green spaces, and elegantly designed public areas. Residents enjoy seamless access to major road networks, ensuring effortless connectivity to key destinations across Dubai while relishing the privacy and exclusivity of a resort-style retreat.

  • Dubai Marina – 20 minutes
  • Downtown Dubai & Burj Khalifa – 25 minutes
  • Palm Jumeirah – 22 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport (DXB) – 30 minutes
  • Al Maktoum International Airport – 25 minutes
